title: A Charged Reduction of the Spacetime Penrose Inequality in Spatial Dimensions at Least Four
summary: Using the companion neutral spacetime Penrose theorem exactly at its stated strong-decay, future-trapped, positive-area, and future-timelike scope, we prove the sharp purely electric upper-area inequality in every spatial dimension n ≥ 4 for one-ended charged data satisfying the charged dominant energy condition and $`\mathop{\mathrm{div}}\nolimits _g E=0`$, with the specified decay, integrability, and finite-flux assumptions.
